stories.title: LIVE UPDATES: Army detonating nation's stockpile of lead azide in Iowa
stories.summary: After several delays, the U.S. Army is detonating a stockpile of lead azide that officials say is unsafe to move due to the risk of spontaneous explosion.

stories.title: Latest maps provided by US Army show potential locations of lead exposure during Wednesday's controlled detonation
stories.summary: The maps outline the potential for where lead may be present in the air and where lead may be deposited on the ground.

stories.title: Atlanta rapper 2 Chainz says he broke two ribs in head-on collision on social media post
stories.summary: A video posted on his Instagram shows two vehicles, an orange Monster Cybertruck and a gray sedan, that appear to be totaled.

stories.title: Man arrested in Florida, charged with murder in connection to 3-year-old's death in Atlanta
stories.summary: The child died from a gunshot wound following a late-night shooting in April in the Peoplestown neighborhood.

stories.title: Traffic Alert: Person hit, killed by vehicle on I-285 NB in Atlanta, police say
stories.summary: Details are limited at this time.

stories.title: 16-year-old boy killed in northwest Atlanta shooting identified
stories.summary: The Fulton County Medical Examiner's Office identified the teen as Daniel Franklin, 16. He died Tuesday at Grady Memorial Hospital.

stories.title: Crash survivor works with local group to support needs of traffic violence victims
stories.summary: Atlantans for Safe Streets, a local group that supports traffic violence victims has relaunched after the recent vigil in Cabbagetown.

stories.title: Traffic Alert: Heavy police presence on I-20 Westbound causing delays in Douglas Co.
stories.summary: Details are limited at this time.

stories.title: McCaysville faces millions in flood damage as city scrambles to recover
stories.summary: The floodwaters are gone, but McCaysville is still feeling the impact. Millions in damage, lost revenue and police layoffs are among the challenges.

stories.title: Bathroom vent fan sparks fire at Cherokee County apartment complex, officials say
stories.summary: The fire was quickly put out.

stories.title: 2 arrested after $50K Newnan Best Buy theft leads to I-85 chase, police say
stories.summary: Coweta County deputies recovered roughly $50,000 in stolen merchandise after stopping the fleeing vehicle near mile marker 50.

stories.title: Suspect arrested for Facebook Marketplace robbery after being spotted by Flock camera
stories.summary: Police say 20-year-old Patrice Saddler Jackson dragged and ran over the victim with her car after taking a cell phone without paying at a Buford Drive gas station.
